proposals.evidence: DEDR399 gives Tamil/Malayalam āṇ male and4198 piḷḷai/piḷḷa child. LSI ampūlle Son is analysed as male + child, with nasal assimilation before p; its second member agrees with the same survey’s separately attested pūllē Child. Preserve short a, long ū and undotted ll, and represent both components instead of assigning the entire word to male alone.
